subject.title: Feature: Auto session split when approaching context window limit

question: Should OpenClaw add a core token/context-pressure automatic session rollover policy, and what canonical config, defaults, handoff artifact, authorization, and delivery-preservation contract should it use?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix defines new public session lifecycle configuration plus persisted handoff/routing behavior that must be product-owned before code is safe.

options.title: Add opt-in rollover policy
options.body: Add a disabled-by-default core context-pressure rollover policy with explicit thresholds, durable handoff, same logical session key, delivery preservation, docs, and upgrade tests.

options.title: Fold into TTL/session lifecycle design
options.body: Keep this issue open but implement it alongside the related session TTL/max-lifetime work so OpenClaw has one session-rotation policy family.

options.title: Defer automatic rollover
options.body: Keep existing compaction/manual reset mitigations and document operational guidance without adding new core lifecycle config now.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in rollover policy
recommendation.body: Add a disabled-by-default core context-pressure rollover policy with explicit thresholds, durable handoff, same logical session key, delivery preservation, docs, and upgrade tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the broadest available routing candidate across agent runtime, session lifecycle, compaction, and config surfaces, while the final choice still needs maintainer product direction.
